players.bio: Adalberto Eliécer Carrasquilla Alcázar (born 28 November 1998), commonly known as Coco Carrasquilla is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club UNAM and the Panama national team.
Alan Medina Camacho (born 19 August 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club Querétaro.

César Saúl Huerta Valera (born 3 December 2000), commonly known as "Chino Huerta", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Belgian Pro League club Anderlecht and the Mexico national team.

Cristian Yonathan Calderón Del Real (born 24 May 1997), commonly known as "Chicote Calderón", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Liga MX club Necaxa Club career Early career Calderón participated in the youth teams of Coras de Nayarit FC and C.D. De los Altos before joining Altas FC's youth team.
José Luis Caicedo Barrera (born 23 May 2002) is a Colombian footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and sweeper for Major League Soccer club Portland Timbers.
Olávio Vieira dos Santos Júnior (born 21 November 1996), commonly known as Juninho, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Flamengo.

Keilor Antonio "Keylor" Navas Gamboa (Spanish: ; born 15 December 1986) is a Costa Rican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Newell's Old Boys. He is regarded as one of the best goalkeepers of his generation. Navas started his youth career at Saprissa in his home country, where he won six Liga FPD titles.

Nathanael Ananias da Silva (born 6 May 1997), known as Nathan Silva or simply Nathan, is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Atlético Mineiro. Mainly a central defender, he can also play as a defensive midfielder.

Pedro Jeampierre Vite Uca (born 9 March 2002) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club UNAM and the Ecuador national team. Vite came up through the youth system at Independiente del Valle, going on to help the team win the U-20 Copa Libertadores in 2020.

Rubén Duarte Sánchez (born 18 October 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Liga MX club UNAM. Mainly a left-back, he can also play as a central defender. He made his La Liga debut with Espanyol, and spent most of his career with Alavés, totalling 231 appearances in seven seasons.

Santiago López López, born on 10 June 2005, is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-forward. He is a dual-national player connected to both Mexico and Canada. López developed his skills in the youth system of the Mexican club Pumas UNAM. He made his way to their first team, playing in Liga MX and the CONCACAF Champions Cup.

Antonio Jeremiah "Tony" Leone Larios (born April 28, 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Monterrey. Born in the United States, he plays for the Mexico national under-23 team.
Carlos Uriel Antuna Romero (born 21 August 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club Tigres UANL and the Mexico national team.
